measurements.scope: Stabeno et al. (2016) report an approximate 1,700 km coastal system between Seward and Samalga Pass. This is the northern Gulf of Alaska/eastern Aleutian scope, separate from the offshore Alaska Current and Alaskan Stream. It does not cover every coastal flow sharing the Alaska Coastal Current name, including Arctic usage. The paper integrates intermittent observations from 1984-2014; this extent is not a measured simultaneous reference streamline or dated footprint.
measurements.source_locator: Accepted manuscript, PDF page 2, Abstract, lines 25-28 (~1700 km, Seward to Samalga Pass); PDF page 3, Introduction, lines 51-59 defines the regional continuity scope.
